intent.idea: A short fictional suspense story with a genuine reveal: a lighthouse keeper in a storm sees a huge dark shape closing on the rock, and has to choose whether to hide the light
intent.audience: people scrolling short vertical video on a phone
intent.intended_effect: suspense that turns into tenderness at the reveal

premise.title: The Keeper
premise.opening_image: A lighthouse on a black rock in a storm, its beam sweeping an empty sea; a small keeper in a yellow oilskin turns the lamp by hand.
premise.audience_hook: What is the huge dark shape the beam just caught under the waves, and will she hide the light?
premise.central_action: The keeper tracks a giant shape with a glinting eye as it closes on the rock, starts to shutter the lamp to hide, hears it moan, and instead turns the full beam onto it.
premise.complication: Every clue (the swell, the size of its shadow in the lightning, the moan) says monster, and hiding is the safe choice.
premise.payoff: A whale calf surfaces in the beam, small and crying; she swings the light out to sea, a vast tail rises where it ends, and the calf swims home. At dawn two spouts rise from a sea that was never empty.

intent.logline: A lighthouse keeper spots a giant shape closing on her rock in a storm, chooses to shine the light instead of hiding it, and finds a lost whale calf she guides home.
intent.opening_promise: A storm, a lighthouse and a keeper whose nightly routine is turning the light over a sea that is always empty.
intent.ending: Dawn over a calm sea: the lamp goes dark for the day, Ada waves from the gallery, and two spouts, one big and one small, rise on the horizon. 'The sea had never been empty.'
intent.style: Painterly chiaroscuro night: deep teal and navy shapes, soft gradients, a warm additive beam as the only strong light, lightning flashes, rain, film grain and vignette; dawn turns the same shapes peach and blue.

audio_intent.music: sparse original pad and celesta notes synthesised in code
audio_intent.sfx: seeded procedural storm, surf, drone, cup, whale calls

shot_plan.purpose: establish the ritual and the empty sea
shot_plan.sees: the storm and the sweeping beam, Ada cranking the lamp with tea at hand, the beam passing over empty water
the beam crosses a huge dark mass under the waves and an eye glints; Ada stops the lamp, swings back and finds it closer; she drops her cup; lightning shows its shadow under the swell beside the rock
Ada reaches for the shutter lever and the light starts to dim; a moan rises from the sea; she stops, sets her jaw, throws the shutter open and steers the full beam down onto the shape
in the beam a small whale calf surfaces, blinks, spouts and cries; Ada's face softens, hand on heart
Ada lays the beam across the sea; far out where it ends a vast tail rises and answers; the calf turns and swims along the beam toward it
rain stops, the sky turns to dawn, the lamp goes dark, two spouts rise on the horizon and Ada waves

narration.text: Every night, Ada kept the light turning.
And every night, the sea stayed empty.
So Ada did what the light was for.
The sea had never been empty.
